name: Soccer Fire
description: ⚽🔥 punctuates wins and milestones. The combo reads as the louder alternative to a single 🎉. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.
meaning: Used to mark a moment the sender wants punctuated with confetti. ⚽🔥 shows up on big news — engagements, grad photos, new jobs, new houses. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.

faqs.question: Is ⚽🔥 passive-aggressive?
faqs.answer: No — ⚽🔥 is unambiguous in its celebration-coded register. A sender who wants to be passive-aggressive will write the sarcasm separately.

faqs.question: What does ⚽🔥 mean on New Year?
faqs.answer: On New Year, ⚽🔥 is exactly the register. The celebration cue matches the midnight-coded moment without needing extra context.

faqs.question: Does ⚽🔥 work on Twitter?
faqs.answer: On Twitter, ⚽🔥 punctuates milestone tweets and announcement threads. The celebration register is the same as on iMessage.

faqs.question: What does ⚽🔥 mean on graduation?
faqs.answer: On graduation ⚽🔥 is the default celebration reaction. The combo carries enough weight for the card, the post, and the comment thread.
